# mtncloud_blueprint (Data Source)

Provides a MTN Cloud blueprint data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_blueprint" "example_blueprint" {
  name = "TF Example Blueprint"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the blueprint
- `name` (String) The name of the blueprint
